note: Homepage design changelog that drives the REVISIONS table. Oldest first. Fields: rev, label (shown as DESCRIPTION), eng (initials), date (MM/DD/YYYY), desc, changes. Add a rev by appending an entry, then run: python3 src/build.py

revs.label: PRE-RELEASE
changes: Homepage drawn as a print set of six sheets in the style of a SolidWorks drawing: zone border, revisions table, full title block, dimension lines and a drafting typeface.
Cover sheet shows an isometric shop with a bill of materials of six lines, each linked to a balloon and a zone in the drawing.
Sheets flip one at a time, peeling from the top right corner like a clipped print set.
Quote field on the Instant quotes sheet. Sample data, shops anonymized.
Provider names, provider counts and route framing removed. Copy speaks to every machine shop.
Title block fields give quick facts on hover, focus or tap, and open details on click.
Scannable QR code to overdrafter.com in the bottom left corner, generated locally.
Revisions table added. This entry is the first.
